rows.name: descriptor
rows.body: const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(process, 'reallyExit'); log(typeof d.value, d.enumerable, d.writable, d.configurable, process.reallyExit.name, process.reallyExit.length);

rows.name: exit-calls-patched
rows.body: const o = process.reallyExit; process.reallyExit = function (c) { log('patched', c, this === process, process.exitCode); o.call(process, c); }; process.on('exit', c => log('exit', c)); process.exit(3);

rows.name: direct-skips-exit-event
rows.body: process.on('exit', c => log('exit', c)); process.exitCode = 5; process.reallyExit(7); log('after');

rows.name: natural-end-skips-patched
rows.body: const o = process.reallyExit; process.reallyExit = function (c) { log('patched', c); o.call(process, c); }; process.on('exit', c => log('exit', c)); process.exitCode = 2;

rows.name: uncaught-skips-patched
rows.body: const o = process.reallyExit; process.reallyExit = function (c) { log('patched', c); o.call(process, c); }; process.on('exit', c => log('exit', c)); process.on('uncaughtException', () => { log('caught'); process.exitCode = 6; });  setTimeout(() => { throw new Error('boom'); }, 0);

rows.name: patched-returns
rows.body: process.reallyExit = function (c) { log('patched', c); }; process.on('exit', c => log('exit', c)); const value = process.exit(4); log('continued', typeof value); setTimeout(() => log('timer'), 0);

rows.name: exit-twice
rows.body: let n = 0; const o = process.reallyExit; process.reallyExit = function (c) { log('patched', c, ++n); if (n === 2) o.call(process, c); }; process.on('exit', c => log('exit', c)); process.exit(1); process.exit(8);
